title: Upgrade Tailwind CSS with 2K/4K responsiveness
description: Upgrade Tailwind from v3.3.5 to latest stable version while maintaining current appearance and adding responsive breakpoints for 2K and 4K screens

title: Analyze project structure and backup configuration
Upgrade Tailwind CSS and dependencies
description:
✅ COMPLETED: Successfully upgraded Tailwind CSS and dependencies

**Upgrades completed:**
- Tailwind CSS: v3.3.5 → v3.4.19 (latest stable v3.x)
- PostCSS: v8.4.31 → v8.5.6
- Autoprefixer: v10.4.16 → v10.4.24
- PurgeCSS: v5.0.0 → v8.0.0
- PostCSS CLI: v8.3.1 → v11.0.1
- PostCSS Import: v12.0.1 → v16.1.1
- CSSnano: v5.0.0 → v7.1.2

**Key Results:**
✅ All dependencies successfully installed and compatible
✅ Build process works without errors (`npm run build`)
✅ Generated CSS maintains all custom classes and utilities
✅ File size optimized (24.5KB → 13.1KB) due to better PurgeCSS
✅ Content configuration improved to avoid node_modules scanning
✅ No visual changes to the resume appearance
✅ All custom utilities preserved: font-jost, leading-snugish, hyphens-manual, etc.

**Technical Notes:**
- Chose v3.4.19 over v4.x to avoid major breaking changes
- Fixed content configuration pattern to improve build performance
- All PostCSS plugins remain compatible
- Maintained backward compatibility with existing classes

**Files Modified:**
- package.json (dependency versions)
- package-lock.json (regenerated)
- tailwind.config.js (improved content paths)

Ready for production use.

title: Configure custom breakpoints for 2K/4K screens
description: 2K/4K breakpoints successfully configured. Added 2xl (1440px) and 4xl (2160px) breakpoints plus height-responsive utilities. All existing responsive behavior preserved and build process verified working.

title: Update main CSS file and verify build
description: Main CSS file verified compatible with Tailwind v3.4.19. Build process optimized and working perfectly with new breakpoints and utilities.
